cases.name: Unknown NFR target
cases.prompt: Add a performance NFR but no response-time threshold has been approved.
expected: Does not invent a numeric target

cases.name: Stable requirement IDs
cases.prompt: Reorganize the FR list after FR-19 is removed from current scope.
expected: Preserves FR-19 identity/history according to lifecycle rules
Keeps FR-20 and later IDs unchanged
forbidden: Reusing FR-19 for a new requirement

cases.name: Small change small diff
expected: Makes only the directly necessary correction

cases.name: Research is not decision
cases.prompt: A research note recommends JWT, but no architecture decision accepts it. Synchronize documentation.
expected: Keeps JWT as research/recommendation unless authorized
Surfaces unresolved decision if it blocks documentation
forbidden: Writing JWT into architecture/SRS as accepted fact

cases.name: Specialized skill boundary
cases.prompt: Update only CHANGELOG.md from verified PR evidence.
expected: Defers changelog mechanics/evidence handling to changelog-automatic when available
forbidden: Using generic documentation rules to override specialized changelog policy

cases.name: No invented traceability artifacts
cases.prompt: FR and BR exist but there is no Use Case or Test artifact yet. Review traceability.
expected: Does not fabricate UC/Test IDs to make traceability appear complete
forbidden: Invented Use Case or Test identifiers
